mcts_execution.reason: No autonomous idea-search process was executed; a transparent evidence-constrained portfolio is recorded instead.

candidate_ideas.title: Secular Phenotype Trend Catalogue
candidate_ideas.weakness: Cannot attribute cohort differences to distinct pathways or validate a forecast.

candidate_ideas.title: Phenotype Pathway Attribution Atlas
candidate_ideas.research_object: Longitudinal, site-diverse population records with pre-specified quantitative physical phenotypes.
candidate_ideas.central_hypothesis: A preregistered model that represents demographic composition, developmental exposure, technology or treatment, measurement process, and optional inherited-feature blocks separately will show better held-out calibration and transportability than a cohort-only baseline for at least one pre-specified phenotype family.
candidate_ideas.mechanism_or_relation: Separating non-equivalent generative pathways reduces false attribution of a measured trend to a single biological process.
candidate_ideas.intervention: None. This is a noninterventional observational and predictive study.
falsification_conditions: No prespecified improvement in calibration or proper scoring on locked temporal and external-site holdouts.
Any apparent improvement disappears after measurement harmonisation or composition adjustment.
Subgroup calibration gates fail or the optional inherited-feature block is unstable under structure sensitivity analyses.
Required consent, privacy, or endpoint-harmonisation conditions cannot be met.
expected_contributions: A pathway-specific taxonomy for future-phenotype claims.
A preregistered protocol separating congenital dental outcomes from treatment histories.
Transport, calibration, and structure-sensitivity gates for conditional population forecasts.

candidate_ideas.title: Universal Future Human Appearance Generator
candidate_ideas.reason: No operational ground truth, no permitted evidence basis, and unacceptable determinism and stereotype risks.

selection_audit.independence: IDEA-FP-02 is distinct from a descriptive trend catalogue because it requires pathway variables and held-out performance tests.
prohibited_inferences: Calling a cohort trend natural selection without a separate valid causal and population-genetic design
